parameters.content:
## WF4 Work orders and approvals
Drafts an inspection order from a WF3 escalation (Gemini writes the summary, fixed template if AI fails), or a manager-requested order from the dashboard. Every order is checked against land obligations by v2 W8: notice owed sets awaiting_notice and earliest_start = now + the longest notice_hours; a failed check is unverified. Every decision (approve, reject, tier override, landowner notice) goes to v2 W9 /decide first, and WF4 changes a table only after W9 answers 200. If a table write fails after W9's 200, it is retried once, then logged to corridor_audit (override_not_applied, decision_not_applied, notice_not_applied) with the ledger seq for reconciliation. An order with no obligation check cannot be approved. An order waiting 14 days for approval expires (orders waiting on notice do not); it stays visible and can be redrafted. Orders drafted by the hackathon WF4 (they carry a resume_url) stay with it until switch day: v2 does not decide, take notice on, redraft or expire them.

**Trigger:** Called by v2 · WF3 only (the trigger node name still says "Workflow 2 or 3"); POST https://chlooood.app.n8n.cloud/webhook/terracorridor-v2/action; daily 05:30 expiry
**Auth:** /action needs Header Auth, credential "TerraCorridor v2 webhook key". WF4 sends the same key to W8 and W9.
**Body:** { action: approve_work_order | reject_work_order | override_tier | confirm_notice | redraft_work_order, segment, by (required), work_order_id, details: { reason, to, horizon, start, notice_given_at, how } }
**Reads:** corridor_work_orders
**Writes:** corridor_work_orders, corridor_watch (tier overrides, only after W9 accepts), corridor_audit. Decisions go to corridor_ledger through W9.
**Next:** Approved orders go to **v2 · Email - Approved inspection handoff**, which is archived for now, so nothing is emailed

Part of the v2 set. Hackathon originals are untouched. The Code nodes here are hand-written, not generated from the repo.
